title: Framework learnings promotion registry
description: Idempotent, auditable registry of durable learnings promoted from machine-local memory into the framework. One entry per learning; id equals the memory frontmatter name.

id.description: Stable id; equals the memory frontmatter `name` slug.

status.description: reported = proposal recorded; applied = durable fix embedded in framework; pruned = source memory removed after verified promotion.

auto_apply.description: true only for well-understood, low-risk edits. A change to gate/policy semantics MUST be false (propose-only).

matches_memory.description: Memory frontmatter `name` slugs this learning promotes.

sentinels.description: Exact substrings that MUST be present in the named framework files for the promotion to count as embedded. Deterministic, no LLM.

contains.description: Exact substring that must appear in the file.

test.description: Repo-relative path of the regression test that must exist for the promotion to be considered verified.

durable_fix.description: One-line description of the durable framework change this learning corresponds to.

changed_files.description: Files changed by the promotion, with the sha256 recorded at apply time.

proposed_at.description: First time this learning was recorded as a proposal (status reported).
